paragraphs.text: Lyra Dawnbringer is an angel Commander of the Serra Angels of the Order of Dawn and Protector of Benalia on Dominaria .

Lyra is the leader of the Order of Dawn on Dominaria , named for the famous angel Reya Dawnbringer . Reya died defending Benalia during the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria . Now Lyra continues Reya's mission of protecting Benalia and is sometimes accused of being too involved in Benalish political affairs, a course of action she is more likely to justify than to deny.

Lyra barred the entrance of Gideon and Liliana at the gates of the Benalia City , stating that the necromancer could not enter. After Gideon clarified that they were going to kill Belzenlok , and especially after Lyra read a letter of recommendation sent by Rael explaining the help of the two planeswalkers in Josu's defeat, Lyra agreed with Liliana's entry into the city.

By 4562 AR , Lyra was leading the remaining Serrans on Dominaria, and had negotiated a new peace between Benalia and the neighbouring merchant nation of Orvada . During the New Phyrexian Invasion , she was on the front lines, leading the Benalish forces. As part of their victory celebrations when the war was won, Lyra received an honorary knighthood from Danitha Capashen .

In the Echoverse , Lyra is the headmaster of the Tolarian Academy . Her interest in mechanical constructs was sparked by the Second Brothers' War, and she came to believe that artifice was a path through which she could do great works for the world. Her thirst for knowledge and experimentation led her to a storied career at Tolaria. It wasn't long before other angels decided to follow her.
